Saturna Capital Has Decreased Stake in Facebook Class A (FB) as Valuation Declined; Pinnacle Finl Partners (PNFP) Valuation Declined While Aquiline Capital Partners Decreased Holding by $49.97 Million 
April 17, 2018 - By Richard Conner 
Saturna Capital Corp decreased its stake in Facebook Class A (FB) by 31.66% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Saturna Capital Corp sold 5,792 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 12,501 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.21M, down from 18,293 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Saturna Capital Corp who had been investing in Facebook Class A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $488.37 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.19% or $3.61 during the last trading session, reaching $168.44. About 15.46M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500. 
Aquiline Capital Partners Llc decreased its stake in Pinnacle Finl Partners Inc (PNFP) by 22.85% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aquiline Capital Partners Llc sold 757,060 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.68% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.56 million shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $169.44M, down from 3.31 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. (NASDAQ:PNFP) has declined 0.40% since April 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.95% the S&P500.
